_doc: Canonical runtime config for Amberstone ops stack. This is the single source of truth for the supervisor, file bridge, and self-monitor. config/runtime.json is a legacy install-time file and is not read by the ops stack.
_paths_note: Path values are repo-relative (MAIN 2246 sec 3: no machine path in a tracked file). Readers resolve them against the checkout root derived from their own file location (ops/rc_supervisor.py resolve_config_paths), never the process CWD; an absolute value is a per-host override.
_admin_bridge_note: Set true ONLY for manual development sessions. NEVER in production. Enables shell/start_process in DevRuntime and run_powershell in FileBridge.
_self_monitor_note: Primary self-monitor settings live in config/self_monitor_profile.json. Settings below are supervisor-level overrides.
_authority_note: Config hierarchy: ops/rc_config.json (ops stack) > config/self_monitor_profile.json (monitor) > config/coach_settings.json (AI coaching). config/runtime.json is install-only, ignored at runtime.
